images.caption: Obverse (front) side of the gold Pulitzer Prize for Public Service medal, which also serves as a symbol of the Pulitzer Prizes in general. It features a profile portrait of Benjamin Franklin with the Latin words "Honoris Causa" (in English: "honorary") and "Awarded by Columbia University to", leaving the area for the award recipient's name blank.
images.alt: Obverse (front) side of the gold Pulitzer Prize for Public Service medal, which also serves as a symbol of the Pulitzer Prizes in general. It features a profile portrait of Benjamin Franklin with the Latin words "Honoris Causa" (in English: "honorary") and "Awarded by Columbia University to", leaving the area for the award recipient's name blank.

images.caption: Reverse side of the gold Pulitzer Prize for Public Service medal, which also serves as a symbol of the Pulitzer Prizes in general. It features an image of a bare-chested man using a hand printing press with the words: "For the Most Disinterested and Meritorious Public Service Rendered by Any American Newspaper During the Year 19__"—leaving the last two digits of the year blank—and "Joseph Pulitzer Prize".
images.alt: Reverse side of the gold Pulitzer Prize for Public Service medal, which also serves as a symbol of the Pulitzer Prizes in general. It features an image of a bare-chested man using a hand printing press with the words: "For the Most Disinterested and Meritorious Public Service Rendered by Any American Newspaper During the Year 19__"—leaving the last two digits of the year blank—and "Joseph Pulitzer Prize".
